# Leaf temperature under drought stress

This dataset contains hourly leaf temperature measurements from 12 potted maize plants grown under well-watered and drought conditions in a greenhouse in 2025. Data are processed (cleaned, hourly means).

## Files and folder structure

- `data/leaf_temp.csv` — hourly leaf temperature per plant.
- `data_dictionary.csv` — definitions of every column, with units.
- `manifest-sha256.txt` — SHA-256 checksums.

## Variables

See `data_dictionary.csv`. Units are given for each column.

## Missing data

Missing values are coded as `NA`.

## Software

Any spreadsheet or Python/R can read the CSV files. No consensus standard exists for this data type; we follow the format described here.

## Access and reuse

Released under CC-BY-4.0 with no access restrictions. No human participants.
